ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $UserRole.DeveloperName == 'Back_office', OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Key_Account__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Account_External_ID__c))), AND( ISBLANK(Key_Account__c), ISBLANK(Account_External_ID__c), ISPICKVAL(L3_Snacks_Value_Segmentation__c, "") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Provide Key Account or Account External ID (not both), or PS Value Segmentation Snacks only when both are blank.
